name: Goa State Commission for Women
address: Junta House, 3rd Lift, 4th Floor, 18th June Road, Panaji, Goa - 403001
notes: Statutory body that takes complaints of crimes and harassment against women. 0832-2421080, fax 0832-2232630 and the email are from the NCW list of state commissions (Goa entry last updated 06.04.2022); office number 2437748 (published without STD code; Goa code is 0832) is from the Goa Government iGOOD directory (dip.goa.gov.in/igood/viewSubCategoryOneDetails/Mjcy).

name: Goa State Legal Services Authority
address: Goa State Legal Services Authority, High Court of Bombay at Goa, Penha-De-Franca, Porvorim, Goa - 403525
notes: Free legal aid and advice, including for women and survivors of violence. 15100 is the NALSA legal aid helpline.

name: Women Helpline 181 (Goa)
notes: Toll-free Universal Women Helpline for women affected by violence; refers to police, hospital, ambulance, DLSA, Protection Officer and One Stop Centre. Operated by GVK EMRI from Goa Medical College, Bambolim since September 2018 (per DWCD Citizen Charter).

name: Goa Police Women's Helpline 1091
notes: Answered at the State Police Control Room, Police Headquarters, Panaji, which also runs Dial 112. Control room office: 0832-2428400 / 2428967.

name: Cyber Crime Police Station, Goa Police
notes: State cyber crime police station (at Crime Branch, Ribandar per search listings; the page itself gives no address). For online financial fraud also call the national helpline 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in. The Goa Police site currently shows unrelated injected spam links in its footer; contact details are from the page body.

name: Cyber Crime Nodal / Grievance Officer, Goa Police
notes: Nodal officer (SP Cyber Crime) and grievance officer (DIGP) for Goa listed on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal; use if a cybercrime complaint is not acted upon.

name: Sakhi One Stop Centre, North Goa
address: C/O District Child Protection Unit, Apna Ghar complex, Merces, Tiswadi, Goa
notes: Medical, police, legal, counselling help and temporary shelter for women facing violence. No phone number for the centre is published on a government site; call 181 (integrated with the OSC) or the Directorate of Women & Child Development, 0832-2235308 / 2426112 (dir-wcd.goa@nic.in). Older government documents place this centre at the Forensic Department, Goa Medical College, Bambolim; the current MWCD directory gives the Merces address.

name: Sakhi One Stop Centre, South Goa
address: C-3-6, Junta House Quarters, Pajifond (Phajifond), Margao, Salcete, Goa
notes: Medical, police, legal, counselling help and temporary shelter for women facing violence; run by NGO Bailancho Ekvott since November 2019 (DWCD Citizen Charter). No phone number for the centre is published on a government site; call 181 or the DWCD South Goa District Cell, 0832-2705050 (A Wing, 4th Floor, Old Collectorate Bldg., Margao).

name: District Legal Services Authority, North Goa
notes: Free legal aid. Number is the office line of the DLSA Secretary, listed under the District & Sessions Court, North Goa (New District Court Complex, Merces, Tiswadi) in the Goa Government directory; no separate DLSA address published. NALSA helpline: 15100.

name: District Legal Services Authority, South Goa
notes: Free legal aid. Office line of the DLSA Secretary, Margao, as published without STD code (Goa code 0832). No separate DLSA address published; the District & Sessions Court, South Goa is at Margao. NALSA helpline: 15100.

name: Women Police Station, North Goa (Panaji)
notes: Police station dedicated to complaints by women. Emergency: 112; women's helpline 1091.

name: Women Police Station, South Goa
notes: Police station dedicated to complaints by women. The email published on this page belongs to the Anti Human Trafficking Unit, Margao. Emergency: 112; women's helpline 1091.

name: Protection Officer (DV Act), ICDS Sattari Block
notes: Protection Officer under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act. Only the Directorate's email and the block office are published; no phone.

name: Protection Officer (DV Act), ICDS Bardez Block
notes: Protection Officer under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act. Only the Directorate's email and the block office are published; no phone.

name: Protection Officer (DV Act), ICDS Ponda Block
notes: Protection Officer under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act; the source lists two POs at this block and files Ponda under South Goa. Only the Directorate's email and the block office are published; no phone.
